about: Wave events (docs/GAME-V3.md section 4.2): one per wave from firstWave on, chosen from the wave's seed and number (src/pirates/wave-events.js eventFor, backend/server/island/wave_events.py event_for: the same steps). A seed-free sequence by wave number picks a base event that is never the one before it; with share 'surprise' of the seed's dice the wave takes another unlocked event instead (never the base nor the wave before's base), so the same event rarely comes twice in a row. 'from' is the first wave an event can come; 'weight' its weight in every weighted pick. The browser keeps a copy in frontend/src/pirates/wave-events.json, and tests keep the two equal and check 'samples' ([wave, seed, event]) in both languages.
